full_judgment: 2. This first miscellaneous appeal arises out of Title Suit No.65 of 1995 filed by respondent Nurul Islam Khan stating, inter alia, that he entered into an agreement on 8-4-93 with his brother, namely, defendant-appellant Habibur Rahman Khan under which the plaintiff was to transfer his 25% share in the company known as Habib Transport Co. Ltd. and the defendant in turn was to execute and register a sale deed in favour of the plaintiff transferring his interest in the land with structures on plot No. 1025 in SA Khatian No.105 corresponding to RS Khatian No.1251/1 in holding No.24/24 measuring 0.16½ acre of land and SA Khatian 591/1, RS Khatian No.1024/468 measuring 0.07, acre totalling 0.235 acre of land. It is alleged in the plaint that the plaintiff performed his part of the contract by transferring his 25% share in the company, but the defendant did not perform his part of the contract about the transfer of immovable property as mentioned before through execution and registration of a deed of sale in favour of the plaintiff. With this averment the plaintiff-respondent Nurul Islam Khan filed the suit against his brother, defendant-appellant Habibur Rahman Khan with a prayer for specific performance of contract. On 25-8-96 the plaintiff filed an application under Order 40, rule 1 of the CPC read with section 151 thereof for attachment of the cargo coaster named MY Ishrat Khan belonging to Habib Transport Company Ltd and appointment of a receiver to manage the same till disposal of the suit. On 26-8-96 the court issued a notice on the defendant to show cause within two days against the prayer of the plaintiff for attachment of the cargo coaster and appointment of a receiver. On 3-9-96 the defendant filed an objection showing cause against the prayer of the plaintiff. On 5-9-1996 the court fixed 21-10-96 for hearing of the plaintiffs application for attachment of the cargo coaster and appointment of a receiver. On 8-9-1996 the plaintiff filed an application for advancing the date of hearing of his application for attachment and appointment of a receiver and the court allowed this prayer advancing the date of hearing from 21-10-1996 to 12-9-96. On 12-9-1996 the defendant filed an application stating that the court had advanced the date of hearing of the matter from 21-10-96 to 12-9-96 without serving copy of the notice on his Advocate, Mr. Ashrabuddin and that a copy was served upon a lawyer holding no power on his behalf and, so, the defendant made a prayer for vacating the order passed on 8-9-96 and for fixing a new date of hearing of the matter. On the same date (12-9-96) the defendant filed another application under Order 7 rule 11 of the CPC for rejection of the plaint and on that date, ie. 12-9-96 the court passed an order fixing 21-9-96 for hearing of the plaintiff’s application for appointment of a receiver and defendant's application for rejection of the plaint under Order 7, rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure adding: "In the meantime cargo coaster named MV Ishrat Khan is attached." It is against this order dated 12-9-96 attaching the cargo coaster that the present first miscellaneous appeal has been preferred by the defendant and he has also obtained a Rule, staying operation of the impugned order passed by the court below.
